units: Selected factual annotations, no exhaustive event count
note: Original paraphrases with primary citations. Coordinates approximate named city/region anchors, not footprints. A date may mark a reporting cutoff rather than the onset of an event; the card says which.

items.title: Full-scale attack
items.text: Russia launched its full-scale armed attack on 24 February 2022. The Kyiv marker anchors the national event, not its only direction.

items.title: Mariupol siege
items.text: OHCHR describes Mariupol as under siege for nearly three months, with intensive bombardment. May marks the end of this reporting interval, not an exact surrender date.

items.title: General Assembly response
items.text: On 2 March the General Assembly demanded Russia end the invasion and withdraw its military forces.
